fib: ______ is a concept, typically defined as the systematic recording of the facts that show the position of a business.
Bookkeeping
Bookkeeping is a concept, typically defined as the systematic recording of the facts that show the position of a business.
______ is used to record a variety of things, most of which consist of accounting adjustments, such as the correction of errors, rather than transactions.
journal
The journal is used to record a variety of things, most of which consist of accounting adjustments, such as the correction of errors, rather than transactions.
______ can be defined as a legal obligation to transfer assets or provide services to another entity that arises from some past transaction or event.
liability
A liability can be defined as a legal obligation to transfer assets or provide services to another entity that arises from some past transaction or event.
______ is a method of bookkeeping that relies on one sided accounting entry to maintain financial information.
single entry bookkeeping
A single entry bookkeeping is a method of bookkeeping that relies on one sided accounting entry to maintain financial information.
______ is a book where goods sold on credit are recorded.
sale day book
The sale day book is a book where goods sold on credit are recorded.
______ is a record in a double entry system that is kept for each class of item.
account
An account is a record in a double entry system that is kept for each class of item.
______ is a method of bookkeeping that relies on two sided accounting entry to maintain financial information.
double entry bookkeeping
A double entry bookkeeping is a method of bookkeeping that relies on two sided accounting entry to maintain financial information.
______ is the system in Accounting whereby every transaction that has to be recorded gives rise to two entries.
Double Entry system
Double Entry system is the system in Accounting whereby every transaction that has to be recorded gives rise to two entries.
______ is a fundamental equation and is a valuable basis from which to begin understanding the whole process of accounting.
accounting equation
The accounting equation is a fundamental equation and is a valuable basis from which to begin understanding the whole process of accounting.
